title: Semaglutide linked to lower predicted dementia risk
ai_summary:

title: AI in drug discovery – what it is, where we stand and the path forward
ai_summary:

• Researchers and pharmaceutical companies are leveraging AI to analyze large datasets and accelerate the discovery process.
• AI's accuracy and speed help reduce the time, cost, and resources required to develop new medicines.
student_angle: This technology represents a rapidly growing area of research, making it worthwhile for students to learn AI and ML principles for future opportunities in the field.

title: Abdominal fat predicts heart disease risk better than BMI

title: RISC-V: They Should Have Known Better
ai_summary:

student_angle: While RISC-V adoption may lead to new hardware development opportunities, its impact on entry-level jobs in the software industry remains limited for now.

title: Tracking down a Zsh history data loss bug
ai_summary:
• Investigation of Zsh history data loss reveals bug in savehistory function.
• Researchers identify cause as incorrect argument order, leading to lost commands.
• Temporarily fixing bug requires editing /etc/zsh/ functions or using zmodload.
